subject: ai
question: What is a crisp set? Differentiate between fuzzy sets and crisp sets.
title: Crisp Step, Fuzzy Ramp
hook: Is 29.9 degrees hot? Crisp says no.
answer: Crisp set: a classical set in which each element either belongs or does not; membership is only 0 or 1 (sharp boundary)
Fuzzy set: allows partial membership, any value from 0 to 1 (gradual boundary)
Boundary: crisp sharp vs fuzzy gradual
Logic: crisp = classical true/false, an element and its complement never overlap; fuzzy = element can belong partly to a set and partly to its opposite
Use: crisp for exact data; fuzzy for vague terms such as hot, tall, young
